title: Find the Slope
problem: Find the slope of the tangent line to $f(x) = x^3 - 4x$ at $x = 2$.

title: Solve the System
problem: Solve the system $\begin{cases}2x + y = 7 \\ x - y = 2\end{cases}$.

title: Find the Area of a Circle
problem: Find the area of a circle with radius $r = 7$ using $A = \pi r^2$.

title: Arithmetic Sequence
problem: Find the $10$th term of the arithmetic sequence $5, 8, 11, 14, \ldots$.

title: Geometric Sequence
problem: Find the $8$th term of the geometric sequence $2, 6, 18, 54, \ldots$.

title: Probability of an Event
problem: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. Find the probability of rolling an even number.

title: Combination Problem
problem: How many different committees of $3$ people can be selected from a group of $10$ people?

title: Pythagorean Theorem
problem: A right triangle has legs of length $6$ and $8$. Find the length of the hypotenuse using $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
